node.statement: Projected-path properties: because the whole straight path lies in the single open polar domain S_delta, H(t,U_0,U_1)=u_delta(Z_t) is jointly continuous, has endpoints U_0,U_1, and is U(1)-equivariant by lem-stage1-polar-retraction and lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality.
